BOOK ONE · LESSON 058

What's the time?

几点钟？

Read clocks and compare usual activities with what people are doing today. 读钟表，并对比日常活动与今天正在进行的活动。

58 / 144 LESSONS3 PARTSREAD · WRITE · PRACTISE
01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

1st: The hour hand points to 1. The minute hand points to 12.

2nd: The hour hand points to 2. The minute hand points to 12.

3rd: The hour hand points to 3. The minute hand points to 12.

4th: The hour hand points to 4. The minute hand points to 12.

5th: The hour hand points to 5. The minute hand points to 12.

6th: The hour hand points to 6. The minute hand points to 12.

7th: The hour hand points to 7. The minute hand points to 12.

8th: The hour hand points to 8. The minute hand points to 12.

9th: The hour hand points to 9. The minute hand points to 12.

10th: The hour hand points to 10. The minute hand points to 12.

11th: The hour hand points to 11. The minute hand points to 12.

12th: Both hands point to 12. The minute hand points to 12.

13th: He usually shaves at seven o’clock every day.
Picture cue: Man shaving beside a clock showing seven.

14th: but today, he ...
Picture cue: The same man shaving beside a clock showing eight.

15th: She usually drinks tea in the morning.
Picture cue: Woman drinking tea beside a teapot.

16th: but this morning, she ...
Picture cue: The same woman drinking coffee beside a coffee pot.

17th: They usually play in the garden in the afternoon.
Picture cue: Two children playing in the garden.

18th: but this afternoon, they ...
Picture cue: The same two children swimming in water.

19th: I usually cook a meal in the evening.
Picture cue: A person cooking a meal at a stove.

20th: but this evening, I ...
Picture cue: The same person reclining and reading a book.

21st: We usually watch television at night.
Picture cue: A family watching television together.

22nd: but tonight, we ...
Picture cue: The same family listening to a stereo.

Listen and answer the questions

Listen and answer the questions. Read the time shown by each numbered clock.

听录音并回答问题。读出每个编号钟表显示的时间。

The recording and its spoken questions were not supplied. Each clock has its minute hand at 12.

They usually ... but today, they are ...

Complete each contrast using the two numbered pictures and their printed sentence beginnings.

根据每组编号图片和印出的句子开头，完成“通常……，但今天……”的对比。

They usually ... but today, they are ... 他们通常……，但是今天他们正……。 The five pairs are numbered 13th–14th, 15th–16th, 17th–18th, 19th–20th and 21st–22nd.
